name: Aratel Island
desc:
Aratel Island is the name given to a large land mass found in the Eastern Luminant, due to it existing in [The Aratel Sea](location:the_aratel_sea).

Most of its surface is either part of the [Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley) or the [Bluster Rift](location:bluster_rift). There are two towns in Aratel Islands, those being [Meteor Isle](location:meteor_isle) and [Fort Merit](location:fort_merit). It is also home to the only Fountain Gate in the [Eastern Luminant](location:luminants), that being in [The Lordsgrove](location:the_lordsgrove). The easiest way to reach the top, where [Starswept Valley](location:the_starswept_valley), [Bluster Rift](location:bluster_rift), and [The Lordsgrove](location:the_lordsgrove) reside, is to climb one of the islands in front of the island, and glide onto the top. It has three voidzones, those being: [Starfield Grove](location:starfield_grove), [Deep Thresher Nest](location:deep_thresher_nest) and the [Lightkeeper Temple](location:lightkeeper_temple). It is dominated by [The Central Authority](faction:the_central_authority) and [The Hundred Legions](faction:the_hundred_legions).
additional_info:
-   Frequently referred to as "Hive" by players.
-   Small, blue meteorites uncommonly fall from Constellia. These meteorites will spawn in Stone Knights.
-   Funny enough, the stationary blue meteors in Meteor Isle won't spawn in Sand Knights. Go figure.
-   A great place to grind for medium-level players, due to the abundance of Threshers and King Threshers.
